notes.title: MacOS Version Released
notes.notes: The Mac version is now ready to rock, whether on your machine or through screen sharing on iPad, etc.

notes.title: Updates in Version 1.2
notes.notes: Trail reconstruction, mobile device UI improvements, game engine update, and chirping bird management. See further notes on the Store Page. Enjoy this update!

notes.title: Version 1.1.0b Update
notes.notes: The Version 1.1.0b Update entails a change in one line of code that fixes a problem where characters late in the game magically disappear, but keep on talking. The disappearance would have appeared to those who followed a very specific series of actions, and although quite humorous, was fairly confusing. All saved games from Version 1.1.0a should continue to work with this new version. Please report if there are any problems discovered. Enjoy!
